formulas.name: Compton shift relation
formulas.when_to_use: To calculate the wavelength change of a photon scattered by a nearly free electron.
common_mistakes: Using the electron scattering angle instead of the photon angle

concepts.definition: Photon wavelength shift after scattering from a free electron initially at rest; θ is the photon scattering angle.
Electron Compton wavelength. This concept is used to interpret the observable physical effect, its measured variables, and the quantitative prediction represented by the formula.

concepts.definition: Photon scattering on an electron changes photon wavelength; evidence for photon momentum.
A scattered photon loses energy when it transfers recoil energy to an initially resting free electron.
concepts.when_to_use: Applicable to free electrons initially at rest.
